question: Harshavardhana, the ruler of Kannauj in 7th century CE, was the king of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushyabhuti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Harshavardhana, also known as Harsha, was the most famous ruler of the **Pushyabhuti dynasty**.
 
• He ascended the throne in the early 7th century CE and ruled over a vast kingdom that included much of northern India.
 
• Under Harsha's rule, the Pushyabhuti dynasty reached its zenith, and he is often credited with significant achievements in both military conquests and cultural advancements.
 
• Harsha was also known for his patronage of arts and literature, and his reign is considered a golden age for the cultural and intellectual history of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushyabhuti Dynasty:**

 
 
• The Pushyabhuti dynasty, also known as the Vardhana dynasty, was an ancient Indian dynasty that rose to prominence in the 6th and 7th centuries CE.
 
• The dynasty's most famous ruler was Harshavardhana, who expanded the empire and played a key role in the political landscape of northern India.
 
• The Pushyabhuti dynasty is known for its contributions to the cultural and religious life of India, including the promotion of Buddhism and the construction of numerous temples and monasteries.
 
 
 
• **Vakataka Dynasty:**
 
 
• The Vakataka dynasty was an ancient Indian dynasty that ruled parts of central and southern India from the 3rd to 5th centuries CE.
 
• The Vakatakas were known for their patronage of the arts, including the construction of the Ajanta Caves, which are renowned for their exquisite murals and sculptures.
 
 
 
• **Chalukya Dynasty:**
 
 
• The Chalukya dynasty was an ancient Indian dynasty that ruled large parts of southern and central India between the 6th and 12th centuries CE.
 
• The Chalukyas are known for their contributions to Indian architecture, including the construction of the rock-cut temples at Badami and the grand temples at Pattadakal.
 
 
 
• **Maukhari Dynasty:**
 
 
• The Maukhari dynasty was a dynasty that ruled parts of northern India in the 6th century CE.
 
• The Maukharis initially served as vassals of the Gupta Empire but later declared their independence and established their own kingdom in the region around modern-day Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.
